responsibility: Provides the z990/z9 scheduling automaton for the S/390 backend, including separate integer, memory, and floating-point pipeline resources, grouped issue restrictions, operand forwarding, and address-generation bypasses. Unlike the simpler z900 model, this file assigns detailed latencies and resource exclusions for z990-class processors and is the main machine description input used by GCC’s scheduler when tuning code for z990, z9-109, and z9-ec CPUs.
